meta.name: debug-broken-ui
meta.description: Find out why something in a running web app does not work, when the console is empty and the code looks correct. Reads the click, the request, the store and the console together and returns the file:line to open. Use when a button does nothing, a form will not submit, data will not load, a page renders blank or stale, a modal will not close, or the user says "it's broken" and the code review says it is fine.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪运行中网页应用的交互故障,给出发出问题的文件与行号
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网页上的点击或加载失效,但代码审查看起来没问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if something in your web app is broken but the code looks fine

howto.what: 当网页应用里某处不工作时,Claude 会驱动页面复现问题,把点击、请求、状态仓库和控制台放在一起读,最后给出该打开的 file:line,而不是靠猜。
howto.when: 当按钮没反应、数据不加载、弹窗关不掉,或你说“坏了”而代码看起来没问题时触发。

say.text: 这个页面的提交按钮点了没反应,帮我查为什么
say.note: 会复现这次点击并给出 file:line

say.text: 列表数据一直加载不出来,但控制台没有报错
say.note: 会去读网络请求和状态仓库的证据

say.text: 用户说坏了,但代码审查说没问题
say.note: 会驱动流程,最后指向具体位置

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces the problem by driving the running page, then reads the click, request, store and console together and returns the file:line to open instead of guessing.
howto.when_en: Use when a button does nothing, data will not load, a modal will not close, or the user says "it's broken" while the code looks fine.

say_en.text: The submit button does nothing when I click it, find out why
say_en.note: It reproduces the click and returns the file:line

say_en.text: My list never loads and the console is empty
say_en.note: It reads the network entry and the store

say_en.text: The user says it's broken but the code looks fine
say_en.note: It drives the flow and points at a location
